facts.title: Flow changes
facts.text: Existing buffs retained, with slight shot curve and stamina bonus added.

facts.title: Passing changes
facts.text: Reduced on-ball speed penalty for pass receivers and improved pass tracking.

history.title: September quality of life
history.text: Watchtower added to Niko. Barou received aim and dribble adjustments; Loki and Lavinho were balanced. One goal counted as 1 MVP point and one save as 0.75. Per-style awakening outfits and party improvements arrived; summer map removed.

history.title: Flow balance and fixes
history.text: Numerous flow buffs and nerfs. Magician Flow moved to Legendary; Emperor cooldown reduction changed from 33% to 20%. Infinite Awakening added to PS+.
